title: P12/P13/P25 conditional instruction modules, shadow: split role prompts into a minimal base plus deterministic modules selected by scope, language and task class; log instruction_loading decisions; rendered prompts byte-identical until active (v2)
spec:
Facts (Planner grep, provenance repo): prompts live in .orchestrator/prompts/*.md and are rendered by spawn.render (spawn.py:101-113, str.replace of double-brace tokens, unfilled check). Sizes: execute.md 1513 B (after the dedup task; carries repo-specific unittest/_harness rules and a tool-call budget), planner.md 4307 B, planner-shadow.md 1110 B, fix-delta.md 849 B, review.md 599 B, spec-review.md 575 B, fix-round.md 550 B, scout.md 537 B, challenge.md 257 B. The P1 telemetry records instruction_tokens per run (rendered prompt minus packet).
Do:
1. Module store: .orchestrators/prompts is wrong; use .orchestrator/prompts/modules/<name>.md. Create modules by moving text out of the existing prompts WITHOUT changing the rendered result in shadow: python-unittest.md (the unittest/_harness/no-pytest rules from execute.md), tool-budget.md (the tool-call budget lines), review-security.md (the security checklist pointer currently added in review_packet's security section stays where it is; this module carries the security-review instructions if any live in review.md, else create it with the two-line trust-boundary reminder from CLAUDE.md "Trust" and mark it mandatory for security_review), docs-task.md (new: for scope that is all .md: "no tests to add; keep line width; link revert path"), migrations.md (new, selected when any scope path matches *migrations* or *alembic*: "never edit an applied migration; add a new revision; downgrade must work"). Fundamental safety rules (never touch files outside scope, never leave uncommitted changes, commit message starts with the task id, report the gate result) stay in the base prompt and are never a module.
2. orchestrator/instructions.py (new): RULES = ordered list of (module, predicate) with deterministic predicates over task fields: role, scope globs, language (by scope suffixes: .py → python; .ts/.tsx → typescript; .swift → swift; .md only → docs), task_class, constraints. `select(task, role) -> {"modules": [...], "mandatory": [...], "reasons": {module: reason}}`. `compose(base_text, modules) -> str` appends modules in RULES order under a single "## conditional instructions" heading. `mode()` reads promotion.mode("conditional_instructions").
3. spawn.render gains an optional `task=` kwarg: when given and mode is off → today's behaviour (the full legacy prompt file, unchanged bytes). When shadow: render the legacy prompt exactly as today AND compute the modular variant (base = the prompt file minus the module texts, plus selected modules) and record decision_log.record(kind="instruction_loading", subject=task id, candidates=all module names, hard_constraints=mandatory, deterministic={"selected", "reasons", "legacy_tokens", "modular_tokens", "delta_tokens"}, selected=modules, reason="deterministic rules v1", mode="shadow"); add instruction_tokens_modular to packet_meta/run context (bus.py copied keys). When active: return the modular variant (this is the only place bytes change, gated by the mode; the mode stays "shadow" in pool.toml).
4. All render call sites (spawn.run_worker execute/review/spec_review/scout/challenge, daemon dispatch and _dispatch_fresh_fix, planner packets if they use render) pass task=. Keep every existing render test green; the legacy files stay as the shadow source of truth so nothing changes for the models.
5. context_scorecard: per-role columns instruction_tokens (avg, from P1) and instruction_tokens_modular (avg) and instruction_reduction.
Tests (unittest): tests/test_instructions.py::test_select_python_scope_loads_unittest_module, ::test_docs_only_scope_loads_docs_module_and_not_unittest, ::test_migration_scope_loads_migration_module, ::test_mandatory_modules_never_dropped; tests/test_spawn.py::test_render_bytes_identical_in_shadow (render with task= in shadow equals render without task= for execute, review, scout), ::test_render_active_appends_selected_modules_only (with mode patched to active the output contains the selected module text once and no unselected module). docs/context-economy/07-instructions.md (≤60 lines): base vs modules, the rule table, what shadow logs, revert path (mode off; the legacy prompt files are untouched).
Do not ask questions; decide and note decisions in the result. Never quote double-brace placeholder tokens literally anywhere in code comments or docs that spawn.render might read; describe them in words.

SPEC v2 (2026-09-22 18:20) after spec review T-0812, binding on top of v1:
- Security-review selection: instructions.select(task, role) takes an optional `signals` dict; spawn.render(..., task=, signals=) receives the already-computed security signals from review_packet (the security section triggers: security_paths glob match, semantic regex match over diff/spec, complexity threshold; spawn.py ~570-586) and passes them through, so review-security.md is selected whenever the review packet carries the security section. Where render is called without signals (execute, scout, spec_review), the module is selected by role only (security_review role) and the limitation is documented: semantic-only triggers are known at packet build time, not from task fields.
- context_scorecard: instruction_tokens_modular and instruction_reduction are covered by tests/test_context_scorecard.py::test_instruction_columns_keyed_like_bus_context (a run row whose context carries instruction_tokens and instruction_tokens_modular yields the per-role columns and instruction_reduction = modular / instruction_tokens; a row without the modular key counts as unmeasured for those columns only) and the keys are added to bus.py's copied-key allowlist in the same commit.
- Facts correction: execute.md measures 1585 B on goal/T-0760 after T-0799 (not 1513 B); measure sizes from the checkout, never from this spec.
acceptance: docs/context-economy/07-instructions.md exists; .orchestrator/prompts/modules/ holds at least python-unittest.md, tool-budget.md, review-security.md, docs-task.md, migrations.md; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0
